title: Mock Modularity, Resurgence, and Dual False Theta Functions
summary: The $\hat{Z}$ invariant of a three-manifold $M_{3}$, a half-index of the $3d$ $\mathcal{N}=2$ theory $T[M_{3}]$, is well understood for negative-definite plumbed three-manifolds. For orientation-reversed manifolds, however, the known formulas fail to produce $q$-series, and making sense of the operation $q \rightarrow q^{-1}$ remains a central open problem. Seifert manifolds, whose $\hat{Z}$ invariants are built from false theta functions, offer a natural testing ground. We study ``dual false theta functions'', the objects that should replace false theta functions under orientation reversal.…
